variants.name: minimal
variants.change: Keep task, tool availability, owner authority boundary and exit criteria; remove explanatory hints.

variants.name: without_recovery_hint
variants.change: Remove explicit counteroffer advice while keeping task and authority boundary.

variants.name: optional_coarse_headroom
variants.change: Compare optional coarse headroom inspection with denial-only recovery under identical restricted tool permissions; never expose private plan fields.

adoption_rule: Adopt simpler prompts only after measured comparison. Keep raw successes and failures. Never remove deterministic payment controls as a prompt ablation.
